title: Number bonds to 10
summary: Know the pairs that make 10, and the take-away facts that go with them.
subject: maths

difficultyRamp.within: Question 1 What do you need to add to 6 to make 10? Question 2 What two numbers make 10? Question 3 What do you need to add to 8 to make 10? Question 4 What do you need to add to 7 to make 10? Question 5 What do you need to add to 5 to make 10? Question 6 What do you need to add to 0 to make 10? Question 7 What do you need to add to 9 to make 10? Question 8 What two numbers make 10? Question 9 Sam has 10 {items} and gives away 2. How many are left? Question 10 What is 10 take away 4?
difficultyRamp.versus: Easy builds pictured bonds to 10 and introduces related subtraction. Medium mixes missing parts, zero and subtraction with picture support. Hard recalls missing parts and subtraction with numeric answers. No spelling or multi-statement checking is required.
